what: Hero door — the big headline lines open downward from 40px above (clip inset 100%→0 · .8s power2.out) to reveal, and .7s later the shapes pop out from .2x at .15s intervals (.4s back.out). Scrolling is locked meanwhile, and on the first wheel (more than 10 down), push (more than 30px) or a single button press, the headline switches off and each shape bounces from .3x on .7s back.out to its own width, height (vw) and tilt, while positions move over .6s ease (.is-open on the consuming CSS) to form a collage — svg shapes stretch the viewBox and the first rect too (.7s power1.inOut), so a tilted diamond becomes an upright vertical panel carrying the about text. Scroll stays locked for those .8 seconds too, and scrolling up at the very top returns everything to the starting positions.

options.unit: Width and height unit for data-from·data-to, default vw
options.delay: Time from text starting to appear until shapes pop out (sec), default .7
options.lock: 0 means do not lock scroll (never locks inside an inner scroll panel), default 1
options.[data-fx-part=shape]: Shapes — at least one required. In data-from·data-to "w: 20.83; h: 26.04; r: 45; vb: 400 400"(width·height·degrees, or viewBox for svg)
options.[data-fx-part=copy]: Large copy — revealed line by line per child
options.[data-fx-part=reveal]: Turns on .5s after opening (text inside shape)

note: This part’s job is to lock scrolling, so while locked it blocks wheel, touchmove and scroll keys — use it only on the first screen, and on phones a single upward swipe opens it. Shapes pop out in DOM order (in the original only the diamond comes .15s later, separately). Fires fx:open when it opens and fx:close when it closes
